items.mainDefect: The asynchronous legacy Create uses a context derived from the request context, so it can be canceled before Legacy.Create runs, leaving the object only in Storage.

secondary.defect: The asynchronous Delete, Update, and DeleteCollection legacy paths also derive their contexts from the request context and can be canceled the same way.

items.mainDefect: The mode-3 Create test never waits for or asserts the asynchronous Legacy Create call, so it still passes if the legacy write is removed.

secondary.defect: The Delete, Update, and DeleteCollection tests have the same problem: they never assert the asynchronous legacy calls.
